project_type: Markdown songwriting knowledge base (Suno AI song production system) with one Python validator. This task adds a new, separate concern: Suno Studio audio-effect plugins as JSON files with embedded JS DSP.
language: Markdown + Python (validator) + JSON files containing embedded JavaScript DSP (the new plugins).
build_system: None. No package manager, no Node. Repo is docs + one Python 3 script.
test_framework: None applicable to plugins. tools/validate-song.py validates SONG LYRIC files only and MUST NOT be run against plugins.
test_command: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('plugins/**/*.plugin.json', recursive=True)]" to confirm every plugin file is valid JSON.
verification_instructions: 1) Validate JSON: run the test_command above; it must exit 0 with no errors. 2) Structural parity: confirm each plugin has id, kind, displayName, description, ports, parameters, source (lang/metadata/code), and top-level ui. 3) Primitive audit: grep each source.code for g.* calls and confirm ONLY confirmed primitives are used (g.input, g.output, g.zero, g.constant, g.mul, g.add, g.sub, g.div, g.abs, g.max, g.min, g.clamp, g.lerp, g.compareLt, g.dbToLin, g.tanh, g.biquad, g.asymmetricOnePole). 4) Docs framing: grep plugins/README.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md for 'Suno Studio' and 'post-render' / 'not lyric tags' framing. DO NOT run tools/validate-song.py.
setup_instructions: No setup. Python 3.9 is available for JSON validation. Node is NOT available (plugins cannot be executed here; treat as UNVERIFIED).
environment_constraints: Plugins CANNOT be executed/tested in this sandbox (no Suno Studio, no Node runtime for the DSP builder). All plugins must be labeled UNVERIFIED / needs-in-Suno-testing. The plugin format and g.* primitive list are REVERSE-ENGINEERED from ONE example the user provided (a 'Transient Shaper'); that example is NOT persisted in the repo, so the spec in the feature steps is the sole source of truth. Only the confirmed g.* primitives may be used; delay/reverb/noise/LFO/oscillator/FFT primitives are UNVERIFIED and forbidden.
contribution_requirements: Work on a new branch off main. Commit locally. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator publishes). Do NOT alter songwriting methodology, agents, SOPs, or song files. Match existing CHANGELOG bullet style. Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: Repo docs use Markdown tables and code blocks. CHANGELOG.md has an [Unreleased]/Added section with dash bullets. README.md has a 'Repository Structure' code block tree. core/README.md and .kiro/README.md have directory-relationship tables.
relevant_files: README.md (Repository Structure block + add Suno Studio Plugins subsection)
directory_structure: core/methodology = canonical method; .kiro = Kiro automation; tools = python validator; references = data tables; examples = sample songs/albums; songs/analysis = user workspace. NEW: plugins/ = Suno Studio audio-effect plugins (post-render), a separate concern.
